name: Ethena
description: Ethena is a synthetic dollar protocol built on Ethereum

methodology.Fees: Staking rewards + yield distribution + mint fees + extra fees
methodology.UserFees: Users pay fees when minting USDe using USDT, USDC or USDtb
methodology.Revenue: Mint Fees and staking rewards portion to Reserve Fund
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Mint Fees and staking rewards distributed to suppliers

Fees.Mint Fees: Users pay fees when minting USDe using USDT, USDC or USDtb.
Fees.Reserve Fund: Staking rewards portion to Reserve Fund.
Fees.sUSDe Staking Rewards: Staking rewards distributed to sUSDe stakers.
Fees.Extra Rewards: Extra rewards distributed to sUSDe stakers.
Fees.Aave Liquidation Fees: Aave liquidation fees distributed to sUSDe stakers.

Revenue.Mint Fees: Users pay fees when minting USDe using USDT, USDC or USDtb.
Revenue.Reserve Fund: Staking rewards portion to Reserve Fund.

SupplySideRevenue.sUSDe Staking Rewards: Staking rewards distributed to sUSDe stakers.
SupplySideRevenue.Extra Rewards: Extra rewards distributed to sUSDe stakers.
SupplySideRevenue.Aave Liquidation Fees: Aave liquidation fees distributed to sUSDe stakers.
